### Line 98

```plato

    //==
    // Validation

    // Whether every edge's Start and End name an existing vertex.
    EdgesInRange(b: Brep3D): Boolean
        => b.Edges.All(e =>
            e.Start.Value >= 0 && e.Start.Value < b.Vertices.Count
            && e.End.Value >= 0 && e.End.Value < b.Vertices.Count);
```
